description: This source file defines a public actor named TranscriptsStore, which manages appending and retrieving transcript entries stored in a local file. It includes initialization logic to read existing data, methods to append new text entries, and retrieve the latest entries, along with an extension to String for appending lines to files.

classes.name: TranscriptsStore
classes.description: A singleton actor for storing, appending, and retrieving transcript entries from a local file in the user's application support directory.

methods.name: init()
methods.description: Initializes the TranscriptsStore by loading existing transcript data from a file, creating directories if necessary, and setting up the internal entries array.

methods.name: append(text:)
methods.description: Appends a new text entry to the transcript log, ensuring the total entries do not exceed the configured limit, and saves the updated log to disk.

methods.name: latest()
methods.description: Returns the current list of transcript entries.
